diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :module.karpenter is redundant because the Helm release already references outputs from that module, establishing the dependency implicitly.
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.eks duplicates its existing implicit dependency through the EKS module outputs used in the manifest and triggers.
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.karpenter duplicates the implicit dependency established by references to the module's role output.
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig to :module.eks duplicates the implicit dependency established by the EKS module output referenced in the provisioner command.

The direct dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_node_pool to :module.eks is redundant: this resource already depends on :resource.helm_release.karpenter, which in turn depends on :module.eks.

The direct dependency from :resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset to :module.eks is redundant because :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig already depends on :module.eks and is an explicit dependency of this resource.

The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster is redundant: :resource.helm_release.karpenter depends on :module.karpenter, which already depends on :data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster.
